title: wedelia linearifolia
intro: Wedelia linearifolia, commonly known as the Mexican daisy or Wedelia, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and parts of Central America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin irritations, due to its numerous health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia linearifolia include reducing pain, inflammation, and fever, as well as exhibiting antiseptic and anti-allergic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
